scope: Offline review of retained AR8030 trial records and capture artifacts; no hardware rerun. Trial labels are recorded experiment labels, not independently attested radio firmware identity.

images.observation: Native trial 156: disconnected receiver UI, not camera video.
Stock recovery after trial 156: camera scene with standby overlay. Overlay rate/latency are not independent measurements.

raw_frame_identity_checks.note: First and last YUYV frames match each capture report SHA-256. Identity checks do not establish fresh camera motion or verify every captured frame.

receipt_artifact_references.note: Counts are references, including repeated artifacts. Relocated entries match the recorded hash. Missing/changed historical references prevent complete reconstruction from the currently retained source files; they do not invalidate separately matched capture reports.

capture_limits: All reports describe 1920x1080 YUYV at nominal 30 fps from a USB grabber.
Four driver-error buffers occurred including warmup in every capture; measured intervals report zero driver-error frames.
Nonblack samples and distinct fingerprints do not establish camera video, motion, RF cadence, latency or radio firmware parity.
